baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ couples the morning opening at ص ب ح with an event of bright disclosure at س ف ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A named time becomes an active threshold: morning reaches the phase at which a cover is cleared and the field becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: The dawn and morning opening supplies the bounded temporal phase that undergoes change.
Uncovering and clearing supplies the active removal of what had screened the scene.
Daybreak and bright disclosure supplies the visible culmination after darkness.

changed_reading.before: Dawn is merely a time-name followed by increasing light.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is a threshold process that actively clears concealment and makes the world legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots permit morning arrival at ص ب ح and journeying or traversing distance at س ف ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival in the morning and travel combine spatially: daybreak opens a route and marks the instant at which movement out of enclosure can begin.

activation_trace.role: Coming in the morning supplies arrival at the temporal threshold.
Journeying and traversing distance turns the newly visible interval into an open route.

changed_reading.before: The clause fixes a local moment at daybreak.
changed_reading.after: The clause marks a departure-and-arrival threshold at which a route opens with the morning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins the lamp branch of ص ب ح to the writing-as-disclosure branch of س ف ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A source of morning light makes an inscription readable, so brightening can be modeled as a page passing from hidden marks to intelligible text.

activation_trace.role: The lamp and source of light supplies the illumination needed for legibility.
Writing and books as disclosure supplies an inscribed field revealed by the light.

changed_reading.after: The dawn behaves like illumination falling on an inscription and releasing its readable content.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The morning-raid and alarm branch of ص ب ح remains tied to the focus noun, while س ف ر supplies abrupt exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: First light removes cover from a field at the same moment that an alarm announces danger, making disclosure sudden and mobilizing rather than serene.

activation_trace.role: The dawn raid and alarm supplies the threatening first-light event.
Uncovering supplies the sudden exposure produced by the alarm event.

changed_reading.after: The dawn is first-light exposure with the force of an alarm that demands immediate response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from an upper covering through rising into warning and cleansing; the focus dawn performs the same choreography by clearing its cover into public visibility. The cosmic transition therefore models commissioned emergence.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering and clearing gives the dawn the action that links the opening sequence.
The morning alarm gives the unveiled dawn a warning function.
An upper wrap supplies the initial covered state from which emergence begins.
Resolute rising into a task supplies the transition from concealment to action.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the public purpose of the emergence.
Purity through removal of grime supplies a cleansing analogue for the dawn's clearing.

structural_cues: 74:1-5 forms a compact sequence of being covered, rising, warning, magnifying, cleansing, and leaving impurity.
74:36 returns to warning immediately after the 74:32-35 oath sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, purposeful rising, warning, cleansing, and the focus's uncovering/alarm branches; I align those actions as one enacted sequence. A live alternative is that the opening only frames the speaker's vocation while dawn remains an external witness.

changed_reading.after: Dawn enacts the movement of a covered agent who rises, clears impediment, and enters public warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrogant subject turns back, then the night itself turns its back before dawn discloses. Dawn becomes the counter-motion to both darkness and deliberate refusal: what advances into clarity separates from what retreats.

activation_trace.role: Bright disclosure supplies the forward visible state opposed to retreat.
Arrogant self-magnification supplies the motive attached to the human retreat.
Night and its darkness supplies the receding condition displaced by dawn.
Turning the back supplies retreat and activates the same root used for the human refusal at 74:23.

structural_cues: The same د ب ر root occurs in the human sequence at 74:23 and the night sequence at 74:33.
74:37 later makes advancing or delaying an explicit binary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated retreat root, arrogant enlargement, night, and bright disclosure; I infer that the human retreat is aligned with receding darkness and dawn marks the opposed direction. Alternatively, the repetition may bind scenes rhetorically without assigning moral direction to dawn itself.

changed_reading.before: Night recedes and dawn appears in a physical alternation.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is the visible counter-direction to arrogant retreat, turning daybreak into a moral orientation point.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disclosed sign does not mechanically produce agreement. Like material put to a test, one visible datum settles knowledge for some, agitates doubt in others, and becomes a fork between guidance and straying.

activation_trace.role: Bright disclosure supplies the apparently clarifying event whose effects diverge.
Testing metal or a person supplies the mechanism by which one datum reveals different internal states.
Settled knowledge after doubt supplies one possible result of disclosure.
Agitated doubt supplies the competing epistemic result.
Straying from a directed course supplies one branch of the resulting bifurcation.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the other branch of the bifurcation.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly gives the same counted sign divergent outcomes: certainty, increased trust, doubt, straying, and guidance.
The lunar, night, and dawn oaths at 74:32-34 immediately follow that divergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test and opposed epistemic outcomes directly before the focus; I infer that dawn's disclosure models how evidence exposes rather than overrides a reader's orientation. A live alternative is that dawn only swears to the warning's magnitude and does not model reception.

changed_reading.after: Disclosure functions as a test: it exposes orientation and can sharpen certainty or resistance without coercing either.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travel branch of س ف ر gains a route topology: there is an arduous ascent, a choice to move forward or remain behind, and a path that is entered. Dawn marks the departure checkpoint at which direction becomes consequential.

activation_trace.role: Morning arrival supplies the journey's temporal checkpoint.
Travel and traversed distance supplies the route mechanism anchored in the focus verb.
An arduous ascent supplies the difficult upward segment of the route.
Advancing forward supplies one available direction after the threshold.
Delay into a later position supplies the opposed directional choice.
Penetrating or proceeding in a path supplies the route's consequential destination.

structural_cues: 74:17 places an arduous ascent before the focus.
74:37 states the forward-or-backward choice, while 74:42 asks how the addressed group entered its destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal travel, ascent, forward movement, delay, and path entry; I infer a single journey graph with dawn as its departure threshold. Alternatively, the movement verbs may remain separate moral and punitive images rather than activate travel in أَسْفَرَ.

changed_reading.after: Dawn is a route-opening checkpoint from which advance, delay, ascent, and destination become accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's lamp-and-writing model is stabilized by books, repeated reminder language, written sheets, and spreading open. Dawn becomes publication: an inscribed warning passes from closed or unread to exposed and legible.

activation_trace.role: A lamp and source of light supplies illumination for the textual field.
Books and writing as disclosure supplies the focus-anchored textual mechanism.
Ordered letters and the written object supplies an actual textual substrate in the context.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the text's repeated communicative function.
A written sheet supplies the page-like object that can become visible.
Published writing supplies the opening and public exposure of the inscribed warning.

structural_cues: 74:31 names written recipients and calls the sign a reminder.
74:49 and 74:54 repeat reminder language, while 74:52 demands individually spread sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus's writing branch plus books, reminder, sheets, and published writing; I infer that increasing daylight is materially analogous to a page opening into legibility. The live alternative is simple thematic adjacency without textual force in أَسْفَرَ.

changed_reading.after: Dawn figures a warning being opened, published, and made readable like an illuminated sheet.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first-light alarm acquires an acoustic and behavioral chain: a sharp striking signal awakens warning, disclosure removes cover, and the exposed hearers recoil and flee under pursuit.

activation_trace.role: The morning raid and alarm supplies the focus's sudden warning event.
Uncovering supplies the exposed field in which response can no longer remain hidden.
A rapid struck sound supplies the alarm's acoustic onset.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the alarm's intended effect.
Recoiling and distancing from a thing supplies the first behavioral response.
Flight and escape supplies the response carried to completion.
A powerful pursuer supplies the pressure that drives continued flight.

structural_cues: 74:8 begins the difficult-day sequence with an auditory strike.
74:36 identifies a warning, and 74:50-51 closes the response image with recoil, flight, and pursuit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a first-light alarm branch, a struck sound, warning, recoil, escape, and pursuit; I supply the causal arrow from alarm through exposure to flight. Alternatively, the signal and animal simile may frame separate episodes without turning dawn itself into the alarm.

changed_reading.before: Dawn is a quiet visual transition.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is a sharp first-light alarm whose disclosure forces an immediate response, including flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once dawn removes a cover, concealment does not simply disappear. The context distinguishes a resistant cover that hides truth from protective covering and forgiving covering that preserve a person from harm or consequence.

activation_trace.role: Removal of a screen supplies the initial exposure against which later coverings differ.
Covering truth supplies the resistant attempt to negate disclosure.
Placing the self within protection supplies a preserving rather than obscuring cover.
Covering a fault while preserving its bearer supplies the final reparative cover.

structural_cues: Covering language attached to rejection occurs before and within 74:31, while 74:56 closes with protection and forgiveness.
The focus's س ف ر branch explicitly begins from removal of a covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering, truth-concealment, self-protection, and forgiving cover; I arrange them as divergent responses and outcomes after exposure. A live alternative is that these are independent lexical contrasts rather than stages organized by dawn.

changed_reading.before: Dawn ends covering by exposing everything.
changed_reading.after: Dawn initiates a contest among coverings: concealment resists exposure, while protection and forgiveness preserve without falsifying it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Light can disclose by marking a surface rather than merely illuminating it. The dawn's lamp and reddish brightness are placed beside blazing fire, heat-altered color, and exposed human surface, producing an ominous model of visibility through scorching.

activation_trace.role: The lamp and light-source branch supplies luminous agency.
Redness and bright appearance supplies a visible color change at dawn.
Bright disclosure supplies the focus-anchored transition into visibility.
Heat that changes color supplies disclosure as a material mark on a surface.
The appearing outer surface supplies the material on which the light's effect becomes visible.
Blazing fire supplies the dangerous luminous source paired with dawn's lamp.
Burning and blackening supplies the transformative severity of the light.

structural_cues: 74:26-29 moves from fire through non-preservation to a visible effect on human surfaces.
The focus follows the long 74:31 discussion of that fire and its testing count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies light, dawn redness, heat-marked color, surface, blazing fire, and burning; I infer a material analogy in which visibility is produced by scorching. Alternatively, the dawn oath may contrast clean natural light with fire rather than share its mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Dawn can ominously prefigure a brightness that makes surfaces visible by altering and marking them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because respiration is not the ordinary force of the focus form. It remains branch-backed because ن ف س B009 explicitly joins the opening of dawn to breath while the focus supplies dawn and clearing; downstream prose should present it only as a somatic analogy, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening of الصبح through أَسْفَرَ can be modeled as a release resembling an exhalation.

activation_trace.role: The morning opening supplies the event that receives a respiratory analogue.
Clearing away a screen supplies release from constriction.
The branch explicitly comparing dawn's opening to breath supplies the somatic mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Dawn exhales into visibility, releasing the world's constricted field like breath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading personifies dawn and is therefore surprising, but both focus inventories explicitly include facial brightness while 74:22 supplies contracted facial affect. Downstream prose should qualify it as an affective counter-image, not claim that the clause lexically says 'face.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bright-beauty branch of ص ب ح and face-brightening branch of س ف ر attach the countenance image directly to both focus roots.

activation_trace.role: Reddish bright beauty supplies dawn's opening countenance.
A face shining into clarity supplies the personified brightening action.
A face contracting from distress or anger supplies the opposing human expression.
Scowling aversion intensifies the closed facial counter-state.

changed_reading.after: Dawn opens a bright face precisely where the resistant observer closes and darkens his own.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This social reading is branch-distant because the focus noun does not require a meal. It remains anchored in the ص ب ح morning-food branch and the explicit failure to feed the poor at 74:44; downstream prose should preserve it only as a provision-time resonance, never as the lexical meaning of الصبح.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The morning drink or food branch of ص ب ح supplies a provision scene within the focus noun.

activation_trace.role: Morning drink, food, or watering supplies a dawn-time scene of distributed provision.
Feeding another supplies the social transfer withheld in the context.
Sustenance that stabilizes a dwelling sharpens the unmet need attached to the poor person.

changed_reading.before: Dawn reveals a scene without changing social relations.
changed_reading.after: Dawn also evokes the morning distribution of sustenance, making failure to feed visible as a refusal of shared provision.

strongest_changes: The opening cover-rise-warn sequence recasts dawn's self-uncovering as commissioned emergence.
The repeated retreat root makes dawn the counter-direction to arrogant withdrawal.
The 74:31 reception split revises disclosure from automatic clarity into an epistemic test.
Books, reminders, and spread sheets stabilize the textual branch of س ف ر as publication and legibility.
The signal-warning-flight chain strengthens the focus's otherwise remote morning-alarm branch.
summary.what_was_special: This very short focus supported several mechanisms without losing lexical anchors: optical clearing, directional travel, textual publication, alarm, material scorching, and even respiratory release. Whole-surah repetition chiefly changed dawn from scenery into an event that exposes orientation and demands response.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath construction may make dawn only a witness to the surrounding warning rather than an enactment of every activated mechanism.
Travel, writing, alarm, meal, and facial branches remain increasingly form-distant from the immediate use of أَسْفَرَ or الصبح and should not be collapsed into one lexical gloss.
The referent and reach of إِنَّهَا at 74:35 remain structurally open here, so no model depends on resolving it.
